name: Angola
description: Angola from the Kingdom of Kongo and Queen Nzinga to Portuguese rule, the slave trade, independence, civil war and oil.

checkpoints.name: Kingdoms
checkpoints.note: The Kingdom of Kongo and Ndongo ruled the land, and the Portuguese came in the 1480s.

checkpoints.name: Colony
checkpoints.note: Portugal founded Luanda in 1576. Millions of Angolans were taken as slaves, and Queen Nzinga fought back.

checkpoints.name: War and peace
checkpoints.note: War against Portugal began in 1961. Independence in 1975 led to civil war until 2002, and oil made a few rich.
